capabilities: Run TypeScript, shell, and AI cells from a Markdown note in dependency order
Execute each code cell in a hardened container via a container engine
Write each cell's result under the cell and full output to a results folder
Schedule workflow notes on cron and require per-note approval
Enforce per-workflow permissions for network, vault read, and vault write
extras: Prominent security warning: workflow notes are executable content that can start containers, reach the network, and modify the vault; scheduled runs and network access are opt-in. A standalone CLI (@vaultore/cli) runs the same workflows outside Obsidian, and detailed specs (Ore format, permissions, sandbox) live in separate documentation files.
problem: Obsidian notes are static text; there is no way to execute code or AI steps written inside a note, chain their outputs, or run a note on a schedule.
